title: Update Asset Folder Open Access Request
description: Toggle open access on an asset folder. An open-access folder is readable by everyone, including anonymous (not logged-in) callers, bypassing group grants. It never confers manage access — creating, importing and deleting still require an explicit group grant.

is_open_access.description: true = readable by everyone including anonymous callers; false = closed-by-default (admins and explicitly granted groups only)
